resolve-conflicts.never: Force-pushes, pushes .github/workflows changes, or runs head code

address-feedback.never: Posts to the pull request, or touches a human thread

publish-feedback.never: Writes to the branch, or posts anything but the recorded replies

review-dependency.never: Posts to the pull request, merges, closes, or pushes under .github/

apply-dependency-verdict.never: Writes to the branch, merges, or closes a security update
